video:video.video:description: On her way home one day, Bella discovered that her husband Luis was having sex with his step-sister Caroline in the car. So she made up her mind to take revenge on Luis. With the help of her best friend, she approached Adrian, Luis's best friend and also his rival...

video:video.video:title: The Bride of the Wolf King
video:video.video:description: My husband, the Wolf King, even if you don’t recognize me after the reincarnation, I will still find you and fall in love with you.

video:video.video:title: Ms. Janitor Turned CEO
video:video.video:description: The female CEO disguises herself as a janitor to inspect the company, but little did she expect to be bullied by the manager. The manager dirties her clothes and even slaps her, threatening to fire her. In that moment, she takes off her coat and reveals a VIP card, saying, Take a good look at who I am. Who will be the one getting fired? You!

video:video.video:title: No Escape From My Ruthless Alpha
video:video.video:description: "I only want her. She's my mate."Ella, a wolf-less maid, is forced to marry the ruthless Alpha Logan instead of her sister. She soon discovers that Logan is her mate and that he's not as bad as everyone says. As she falls in love with him, Ella finds out she's actually a royal princess...

video:video.video:title: A Matter of Sin and Love
video:video.video:description: Ten years ago Christian adopted the enemy's daughter Elena. Ten years later, they fell in love with each other.

video:video.video:title: The Alpha King Is My Second Mate
video:video.video:description: Sasha is about to wed Alpha Spencer, but she’s rejected at the altar. As soon as Spencer makes her a slave, the handsome and powerful Alpha King Xander saves her and says he is her second mate! Poor Sasha can't believe it and she only wants to flee. But the Alpha King spoils her like a princess. She can’t help but fall in love with him. However, the Moon Goddess must be playing a joke on Sasha--Xander has vowed to kill Sasha’s kind because of the power she has.

video:video.video:title: Return of the Lady CEO
video:video.video:description: Rich family Neil’s favorite daughter Catherine was drugged to have sex with a stranger, which was considered a disgrace to the family integrity. After being disinherited by her father, Catherine found out her own sister Renee and fiance Howard were behind all these to set her up and she was then pushed off the roof by them. Eight years later, Catherine came back to the city alive becoming lady CEO of a company to seek for revenge from her enemies. To promise her son a loving family, Catherine contract-married with the stranger father, George Donton, a powerful royal family heir but mistakenly taken as a pizza delivery driver by her. With the discreet help from the Donton family, and a dangerous accident that George saved her life, Catherine finally found out the truth about him and decided to love him with her heart. They joined hands to beat the evils over and restored the peace to the city...

video:video.video:title: Love Again, My Princess
video:video.video:description: In my previous life, I mistrusted my driver’s son, who stole my money with his evil girlfriend and injected HIV into me!!! Now I’m reborn back to school, I will make him taste all the pain he’s given me, expose him in front of everyone for the crap he’s done, and get back in love with my handsome admirer, NYC’s top billionaire!

video:video.video:title: Found a Homeless Lycan to Be My Mate
video:video.video:description: To escape Vincent’s harassment, Isabella holds a tournament to find a strong warrior to marry. Unexpectedly, an unknown rogue named Ethan, accompanied by his daughter Lily, wins the competition and becomes Isabella’s mate. But Ethan is not just any rogue. He is Lycan.After the two switch roles, Vincent launches a surprise attack, forcing Isabella into a desperate battle. In order not to burden Ethan and Lily, Isabella chooses to face Vincent alone, but is quickly overwhelmed and faces imminent danger. At the critical moment, Ethan then easily defeats Vincent—becoming the hero who saves the damsel in distress.

video:video.video:title: Love by Confinement
video:video.video:description: Ava was sent to prison by Liam for causing the death of his friend. After being released, Ava was tortured by Liam and her love for him was tested to its limits, yet little did she know, Liam also endured incredible agony. In the end, the couple let go of their grievances and started a new life together.

video:video.video:title: Desired by the Billionaire Football Star
video:video.video:description: A billionaire NFL quarterback star issues a nationwide manhunt for the woman he had a one-night stand with.

video:video.video:title: My Quintuplets Have Four Dads
video:video.video:description: An ordinary girl accidentally saved a CEO. No one knew about the romance, but her identity was taken away by her gold-digging girlfriend. Afterwards, she was blessed with five babies! These genius babies became the fuse of love.

video:video.video:title: Mr. Williams! Madame Is Dying
video:video.video:description: Madison Evans loved Hunter Williams for 16 years, but was asked to be his mobile blood bank for White Moonlight, Andrea David. Hunter Williams destroyed her family, just to make room for Andrea David. A cancer physical examination report made Madison Evans see his cold-blooded and ruthless true face. When she finally didn't love Hunter Williams, she found that she had been infatuated with the wrong person for 16 years.

video:video.video:title: Love Never Fades
video:video.video:description: Su Ye was framed by Su Ling, the adopted daughter of the Su family, and had a one-night stand with Qin Chongzhou, the president of the Qin family. Five years later, she returned with her children. She must make those enemies pay the price!

video:video.video:title: My Ex-Wife Is a Superwoman
video:video.video:description: She was everything I thought I understood—my wife, my partner, my equal. But after the divorce, I realized how little I truly knew about her. Behind the quiet strength she displayed during our marriage lies an extraordinary world I never imagined. As a renowned figure with unparalleled talents and a heart devoted to justice, she’s not just a woman but a force to be reckoned with. Watching her thrive from a distance, I can’t help but feel a mix of admiration, regret, and longing. She’s my ex-wife, but to the world, she’s a superwoman—and I’m still hopelessly in her orbit.

video:video.video:title: The Female CEO Turned Janitor
video:video.video:description: Who would have thought that the cleaning lady before our eyes is actually a female CEO with a net worth of trillions...

video:video.video:title: Prisoner of Love
video:video.video:description: Jason, new at Berlin Schwingert High, intrigued Joe. Joe, unaware he fell for a boy, felt drawn to Jasons depth. They discussed freedom and frequented their secret rooftop. Meanwhile, Joe, an avid chess player, bonded with an online opponent, whom he mistakenly assumed was a girl, sharing his feelings with Barron.

video:video.video:title: Flash Marriage with my Alpha
video:video.video:description: Pregnant and rejected by my alpha mate. Today I had my first one night stand. It wasn't planned. It was also with a complete stranger. As I lay in bed, I paused when a familiar sense washed over me. The other side, my boyfriend, Ethan, was nearby, and he wasn't alone.You are so tight, girl, Only for you...

video:video.video:title: Move to Countryside, Marry a Billionaire!
video:video.video:description: Forced into a marriage to save her adoptive father, Louise Mitchell leaves the city for the countryside, only to discover her "farmer" husband, Troy Scott, is actually a hidden billionaire. Bound by a three-month contract, their rocky start slowly transforms into trust and passion, as schemes, family conflicts, and secrets test their love.

video:video.video:title: Family Love Takes Me Home
video:video.video:description: Eighteen years ago, Evelyn Lynn ordered the extraction of all of Zoe Lynn’s RH-negative blood to save her grandson, Ben Lynn's life. Abandoned in the middle of nowhere by the butler, Zoe was left to await her death. However, she was discovered by Mark Dunn, a janitor with the same blood type, who found her and gave her a new name, Grace Dunn. Fast forward to the present day, Helen Reed emerges as the new leader of Lynn Group.

video:video.video:title: I Can Never be Yours
video:video.video:description: When fresh-faced college graduate Sheryl Davis has a one-night stand with billionaire Liam Anderson on New Years Eve, she never expects to become his secretary – or watch him mistake her best friend for his mystery woman! As their office chemistry sizzles, Sheryl discovers shes pregnant! Will Liam realize his perfect match has been right in front of him all along?

video:video.video:title: Legally Bound To Love
video:video.video:description: The story follows Leilani, whose adoptive father has been framed by her ex-boyfriend. Desperate for help, she turns to the one man she trusts the least—Diego Marlowe, a ruthless, undefeated attorney who also happens to be her enemy’s future brother-in-law. What begins as a dangerous deal and a fake relationship soon spirals into a high-stakes game of power, secrets, and irresistible attraction. As they use each other to navigate the battles surrounding them, one question lingers: Is Diego truly just her lawyer—or something far more dangerous to her heart?

video:video.video:title: Lycan Princess Won't Be Your Luna
video:video.video:description: Alyssa, the lost princess of the powerful Obsidian Pack, awakens her hidden Lycan heritage after surviving a brutal attack. For years, she endured humiliation as the wolfless Luna of the Silver Moon Pack, married to Alpha Alaric in a contract to stabilize his cursed pack. When she discovers Alaric’s betrayal—his pregnant mistress and his family’s disdain—Alyssa leaves, reclaiming her royal identity. Reunited with her brother, the Lycan King, she uncovers a witchcraft conspiracy that suppressed her and Alaric’s powers. As they confront their past and a vengeful witch, Alyssa must choose between reclaiming her love or forging her own path as a leader. A tale of betrayal, destiny, and fierce redemption.

video:video.video:title: Billionaire Twins: Daddy, Please Take Mommy
video:video.video:description: Five years ago, Hannah, a woman who no one loves, was betrayed by her husband and best friend. After one-night-stand with a strange billionaire, she got pregnant and left with her baby twins.Five years later, Hannah returns with wealth and fame, while her children’s billionaire daddy has been searching for her for five years. Will the family of four reunite? Will Hannah get back everything that belongs to her and get the betrayers punished?

video:video.video:title: Return of that Banished Girl
video:video.video:description: Isabella grew up in a patriarchal home where she and her sister were mistreated in favor of their brother. Despite the odds, she got into Harvard but was forced to quit. With her mother’s help, she left, finished school, and became CEO. When she learned her family planned to marry off her sister to fund her brother’s marriage, she returned to save her mother and sister—this time, determined to fight back.

video:video.video:title: The Hidden Dragon Rider Returns for Justice
video:video.video:description: New short drama 'The Hidden Dragon Rider Returns for Justice' coming soon, please look forward to it.

video:video.video:title: Reborn to Revenge: The Betrayed Luna
video:video.video:description: Melinda encountered Phillips and Laura, restraining her urge to confront them. She bumped into Nelson, who realized she was his Mate. Nelson's longing for her overwhelmed him as she walked away, leaving him in a maddening heartbeat.

video:video.video:title: [Dubbed]Right Person, Wrong Time
video:video.video:description: When the love was so deep that it was difficult to separate, in order to save her mother, she was forced to appear in court and gave false testimony, sending the person she loved most to jail. Now that you are the CEO, there is a huge difference between us. But the flame of love was ignited again.

video:video.video:title: Head Over Heels With My Substitute Wifey
video:video.video:description: Due to a reckless incident where Grace White's younger sister, Amber White, drove under the influence, Woods Group CEO Richard Woods' sister, Alice Woods, has fallen into a coma. Grace's father and malicious stepmother hold her mother's funeral urn hostage, coercing her to marry Richard Woods in Alice's stead to make up for that incident. Little do they know that Grace has already shared an intimate encounter with Richard previously.

video:video.video:title: Revenge on my ex-husband
video:video.video:description: My ex-husband must die

video:video.video:title: Disciplined by My Mafia Master
video:video.video:description: Disciplined by My Mafia Master

video:video.video:title: Mortal World Outshines Nine Heavens
video:video.video:description: A god, disguised as a beggar, married Zhao Muxue, an unloved daughter of a noble family. He left to return to heaven after their wedding night, promising to come back in seven days. But seven years passed on Earth. Zhao Muxue had two children and suffered while waiting for him. Once the god became the ruler of heaven, he returned to Earth, angered by his family's mistreatment, and vowed to protect them.

video:video.video:title: Nikita: Alpha Kings 3-Time Rejected Mate
video:video.video:description: Nikita, a she-wolf from the poorest, weakest New Moon Pack, unexpectedly became the destined mate of the newly appointed Alpha King Vincent Spencer the day after her boyfriend betrayed her. Having been rejected three times before, Nikita had lost faith in love. She wanted to refuse Alpha King Vincent, but he adamantly disagreed. He recognized her as his savior and had fallen for her at first sight.Simultaneously, Nikita discovered that her parents had been brutally murdered, and their killer was hiding within the wealthiest, most powerful Full Moon Pack under Vincents rule. In order to avenge her parents, Nikita reluctantly agreed to become Alpha King Vincents mate and infiltrate the Full Moon Pack for investigation. Thus began a journey of love and bloodshed...

video:video.video:title: The Wallflower And The Alphas
video:video.video:description: Avery Williams is a high school senior wallflower and a transforming werewolf who has two identities inside. One is a wolf, the other is a Veela. Avery tries to handle her werewolf instinct, especially as the approaching mating time drives her out of control.

video:video.video:title: Escape of His Blind Wife
video:video.video:description: She is the daughter of the Lu family, and she carries his flesh and blood in her belly. She was bullied after her family died. One night she failed to escape, but was saved by him when she was in danger! He thought he didnt love her, but in fact she was someone he couldnt live without...

video:video.video:title: Too Late to Regret, Ex-Hubby
video:video.video:description: Olivia Sterling lived in a loveless marriage with her cold and arrogant husband, James Sterling, for seven years. During this period, she witnessed her son Henry being gradually taken away by James ex - girlfriend, Victoria Clark. Olivia became an outsider. At Henrys birthday party, Olivia found herself completely ignored, and then proposed divorce that night. After leaving the cage named marriage, Olivia picked up her work as a talented translator of Joyce again and became closer with her friends brother, Tom Whitmore. At this time, James and son Henry wanted to win Olivia back, but found that the woman who was once regarded as insignificant by them was now out of their reach.

video:video.video:title: The CEO's Secret Love
video:video.video:description: Fifteen years ago, Gu Junxu met a girlBut when she appeared in front of him many years later, he...

video:video.video:title: Perfect Score, Perfect Payback (DUBBED)
video:video.video:description: After being brought back to the wealthy Litt family, Elsa Litt endures constant disdain and bullying from her parents and three brothers—all for the sake of their beloved adopted daughter, Stacy Litt. On the eve of her SATs, Elsa is falsely accused and thrown into juvie for a hit-and-run crime actually committed by Stacy. When the SAT results are released, Elsa walks out of juvie due to lack of evidence—only to be met with her brothers' scorn and ridicule.

video:video.video:title: Taming My Billionaire's Ruthless Desire
video:video.video:description: Jade Garrison, once the adopted daughter of the wealthy Garrison family, faces betrayal and cruelty after the return of Olivia, the biological daughter. Framed and abandoned by her husband, Samuel Fisher, Jade leaves with their unborn child. Five years later, she returns to save her son but is forced into servitude by Samuel. As secrets unravel—Olivia’s manipulations, Samuel’s hidden love, and Jade’s true lineage as the lost heiress of the Carey family—their painful past collides with a chance for redemption. A tale of love, revenge, and forgiveness, where scars heal only when pride falls.

video:video.video:title: Never Mess with Mom
video:video.video:description: She, a quiet laborer toiling tirelessly on a construction site. All she wanted was to give her daughter a normal, peaceful life. But when her daughter was humiliated, bullied, and finally kidnapped at the prestigious school, her rage ignited. The once-invincible warrior who once shook the world, after twelve years in hiding, returned for her daughter! In a single night, the four great families bowed in submission, the underground organization The Mafia was obliterated, and even the Russian mob trembled in terror! They finally understood…The most fearsome wrath does not belong to the powerful and influential—but to a mother who would tear the world apart for her daughter! This is a mothers battlefield. Now betrayed she returns to reclaim it all!

video:video.video:title: Fated to My Bad Boy Alpha
video:video.video:description: Abigail, a wolfless orphan, never expected that her mate would be Alpha Axel—the most infamous playboy in school.Just as they fall in love and start planning their future, Axel's ex-girlfriend returns, claiming she’s pregnant with his child……

video:video.video:title: Reveal, Rise and Reign
video:video.video:description: Lance West generously supports his girlfriend, Lara Olson, throughout her academic journey. Thanks to his financial assistance, she successfully graduates and attains significant financial success, earning tens of millions annually. Despite Lance's unwavering support, Lara callously severs their relationship, citing the gap in their social statuses. However, in the wake of this heartbreak, fate intervenes.

video:video.video:title: Mafia's Captive Bride
video:video.video:description: Mafia boss Sebastian forces Elena into a marriage after she saves his life at her mother's grave. Elena, trapped by Sebastian, fights back, tames him, and falls in love amidst crises.

video:video.video:title: The Mafia's Obsession
video:video.video:description: Augusto Castro can't stand the thought of his only sister Alice getting hitched to some monster man due to an old-school marriage pact from 15 years back. He decides to pull a fast one on the agreement and steps in to marry the notorious mob boss, Pietro, in her place. Little did he know, it was all a love trap set by Pietro.

video:video.video:title: When Love Comes in Disguise
video:video.video:description: Sadie Allen, the young lady of the wealthiest family in the world, finds herself once again forced to go on a blind date. However, in a bid for freedom, she disguises herself in a cleaner's uniform with plans to sabotage the date. Little does she know, her date, Daniel Fox, shares similar feelings of rebellion against his parents' wishes. He dons a security guard's uniform while his assistant wears his clothes to attend the date on his behalf.

video:video.video:title: Stolen Heiress, Unstolen Love
video:video.video:description: Rebecca, a secret billionaire heiress, turned down an marriage to a powerful tycoon for her boyfriend of 10 years—only to catch him cheating with her best friend right in the office. The two, thinking they outranked her, subjected Rebecca to ruthless workplace bullying. Finally, she tossed her black card and revealed her true identity as their big boss, the two kneel in regret, begging for forgiveness. Meanwhile, Leonardo, the suitor Rebecca rejected, infiltrates the company to investigate his fiancée. Will he be able to recognize Rebecca? And can they finally fulfill their unfinished marriage?

video:video.video:title: Python Attack! Run!
video:video.video:description: Claire and her friends head to a remote forest villa for a vacation, but on the first day, she dreams of a giant python attack. As the dream starts to come true, her warnings are dismissed as a joke. The group stumbles into the python’s lair, and even the rescue team underestimates the threat. As chaos unfolds, they finally realize—Claire’s dream was not just a nightmare, but a deadly prophecy.

video:video.video:title: Luminary Love
video:video.video:description: After eighteen years in the countryside, Emily Hale returns home, only to be immediately pressured by her stepmother and stepsister into marrying Leo Braun, the son of the wealthy Brauns. Little do they know, it has always been Emily’s wish to marry Leo, as he had saved her five years prior. This time, Emily returns to marry Leo, who is now blind, as a way to repay his kindness.

video:video.video:title: CEO, Your Wife Runs Away with Your Six Heirs
video:video.video:description: After a night of passion, Evelyn Tomas gives birth to sextuplets. Six years later, a lovely boy stops billionaire Ethan Huntington and hands him a paternity test paper. He corners her and forces her to give him the child.

video:video.video:title: Dean: My Mafia Protector
video:video.video:description: When tailor Megan Shill accidentally kills a mafia heir in self-defense, she seeks protection from Dean Russo—the powerful mafia boss who once promised to keep her safe. As danger closes in, their bond deepens into a fierce romance. But loving Dean means entering a deadly war... and Megan may be the spark that ignites it.

video:video.video:title: Alpha of Aberdeen
video:video.video:description: Chloe, a reserved college student, has a werewolf friend Amelia, and she had no plans to bring herself into Amelia's world. But that all changes when Amelia invites her to the Aberdeen ball, where she meets the Alpha of the pack, Malachi.

video:video.video:title: Sleeping for 30 years, My Brothers Kneel for me
video:video.video:description: Adopted by the Grayson family, May once enjoyed the love of three overprotective older brothers and the warmth of a happy home. However, after the Grayson family’s biological daughter Stella returned, May was treated as a “stand-in” and suffered betrayal and coldness. Misunderstandings and repeated emotional wounds left her heartbroken and disillusioned. Eventually, she volunteered to become a test subject in the “The May Project,” choosing to go into deep sleep for thirty years ...

video:video.video:title: Fiancée's Betrayal, Dante's Inferno
video:video.video:description: Dante Bosch returns home after 3 years in the Marine Raiders on a top secret mission, only to discover not only is his fiancée Lilith pregnant with his brother Virgil's baby, but Virgil has also spent all his money. To add insult to injury, his parents take Virgil's side. After suffering betrayals and humiliations, Dante exposes Virgil's lies with a video at his wedding.

video:video.video:title: Return of the Dragon Lord
video:video.video:description: Ten years ago, Ian Thorn was forced to leave his family to live on his own due to a misunderstanding. Later, a severe accident nearly claimed his life, leaving him on the brink of death. In a stroke of fortune, Arya Shaw, a young woman, intervened, saving him from the precipice. Grateful for her actions, Ian commits to protecting her, and their bond deepens into love, resulting in marriage. However, their life together is fraught with stress and misunderstandings.

video:video.video:title: Sinful Love With Alphas
video:video.video:description: Adea, a prophetic female werewolf, navigates her dreams sensual mysteries. Encountering her persistent stepbrother Shane at Half Moons den, intrigue ensues. Amidst Shanes pursuit, the arrival of stepfather Joshua and his wife unravels hidden truths. A tale of desire, secrets, and family bonds awaits.

video:video.video:title: Spoiled by My Billionaire Baby Daddy
video:video.video:description: Broke and desperate, college student Yuna Lee agrees to a one-night deal with Sejun Han, the cold and powerful heir of a wealthy chaebol family plagued by generations of infertility. When Yuna unexpectedly ends up pregnant—with twins—Sejun is shocked but determined. He brings her into his world, offering protection, luxury, and everything she’s ever been denied.

video:video.video:title: The Divorced Heiress Claims Her Crown
video:video.video:description: Caroline, the beloved heiress of the Donovan family and sister to three protective brothers, was born into a life of privilege. But for love, she concealed her identity and married Hayden, quietly supporting his rise for three years.Until betrayal struck — during a life-threatening childbirth, Hayden chose to save another woman’s child over hers. Heartbroken but resolute, Caroline divorced him, took her daughter, and began to rebuild her life. Now, Hayden must face the painful road to winning her back.

video:video.video:title: Seduce My Ex's Brother-in-Law
video:video.video:description: After heartbreak and family collapse, piano teacher Emily is forced into the world of the elite to save her father. An unexpected encounter with Ethan,the sharp and enigmatic lawyer of the Hawthorne family, leads them to pose as lovers.But as trials, secrets, and betrayals surface, their staged romance grows dangerously real. Emily must summon courage and wit to fight back against the forces determined to destroy her family and future.

video:video.video:title: Daddy’s Kisses? No Thanks!
video:video.video:description: She and he met unexpectedly. Six years later, he was looking for his son, and her relationship with him warmed up in the company group. After all the twists and turns, can the little baby return to his father?

video:video.video:title: My Secret Agent Husband 2
video:video.video:description: After surviving the chaos of their first adventure, Lucas and his secret agent husband, Wyatt, finally settle into a new chapter of their lives. Lucas is thriving as CryptoLink's CEO, while Wyatt juggles his undercover missions. But just when they think they’ve found stability, old threats resurface, new betrayals unfold, and their long-awaited wedding is once again in jeopardy.

video:video.video:title: [Dubbed]Destiny's Keeper
video:video.video:description: He was clearly the strongest man in the world, yet he was mistaken for a beggar

video:video.video:title: Please, Marry My Husband
video:video.video:description: Clara devoted twenty years to her husband and raised his two children, only to be betrayed by them all. Her husband plans a wedding—with her best friend as the bride, her own children standing by their side. Broken and humiliated, Clara decides to disappear, leaving behind a severance letter and a box filled with secrets—proof of everything they’ve done to her. But just when they think she’s gone for good, the wedding is interrupted by the one person they never expected to return. Love, guilt, and revenge explode in this twisted story of betrayal and rebirth.

video:video.video:title: Second Life, the Godfather's Wife
video:video.video:description: During the appointment ceremony for the leader of the Moretti family, Eleanor's fiancé Lucian assassinated the leader, while Eleanor's sister Vivian was jealous of her sister and killed Eleanor, both of whom died. Ten years ago, they chose the day of their fiancé and lived a new life. Eleanor only wanted to live an ordinary life and chose to marry a beggar, while Vivian married Lucian. Unexpectedly, the beggar whom Vivian initially sneered at was actually the renowned Godfather. After enduring hardships, Eleanor finally became Godfather's Wife.

video:video.video:title: I can hear you
video:video.video:description: She lost her hearing because of him, but he doesn't know the truth.

video:video.video:title: Sinful Triangle With Alpha's Twin Mates
video:video.video:description: Twin sisters Azelia and Sylvia were born under the same moon in the mystical forest. Azelia, with her kind heart, saves the injured Alpha wolf king, Gavin. He falls for her at first sight, seeking to make her his Luna. Sylvia, consumed by jealousy, resorts to murdering Amelia and takes her place right before the wedding night. Unbeknownst to Sylvia, Azelia survives, vowing to reclaim her rightful place.

video:video.video:title: The Secret Life of My Penniless Husband
video:video.video:description: Lily Brown may seem like an ordinary girl, but she is actually the daughter of the wealthiest man in the city. She hides her identity and vows to earn money on her own. One day, while at work, she accidentally saves Sean Kent, a CEO in trouble. Despite doing him a great favor, Lily does not take it seriously. However, their love story has already begun.

video:video.video:title: Return of The War Spirit
video:video.video:description: As the strongest warden his fighting power is unparalleled, did not expect to be annulled.

video:video.video:title: Riding into Love
video:video.video:description: Renegade biker Lyon falls in love on the first sight with Kat, a beautiful yet fragile young girl who lands a new job at Lyon's bike shop. As they fall in love, old wounds resurface when Lyon’s pursuer, unwittingly brings danger closer. Bound by love, Lyon and Kat decide to ride on towards a path of confrontation and salvation.

video:video.video:title: Fall Into Sweet Trap [English]
video:video.video:description: A contract marriage, two hearts drawing closer. Caitlin, struggling to survive office politics and her ex-husband's betrayal. Simon, tasked with revitalizing his family's business. When fate leads them into a loveless marriage, will they continue to abide by the contract or bravely pursue their true feelings?

video:video.video:title: Punch me baby
video:video.video:description: Daisy, the main character, had been married to her husband, Kelvin, for years but remained childless. Unwilling to reveal his azoospermia, Kelvin secretly arranged for a sperm donor to get her pregnant. Meanwhile, Daisy struggled with her mother’s serious illness and Kelvin’s infidelity. One day, Daisy saved Rowan, the male protagonist, from a gangster’s attack, and he fell in love with her at first sight. Rowan secretly chose her as his contractual wife. When he discovered her pregnancy, he mistakenly believed she had been unfaithful. Heartbroken, he drowned his sorrows in alcohol, nearly giving the second female lead a chance to take Daisy’s place in his life. It wasn’t until Daisy was kidnapped that Rowan finally uncovered the truth—Daisy’s child was actually his. In the end, Rowan rescued her.

video:video.video:title: (Doublage)JEU DE L'ÉCHANGE DES MARIS
video:video.video:description: Lorsque Lyra feint l'amnésie pour éprouver son mari Marcus, il la livre froidement à son frère Ethan, prétendant être son véritable époux. Elle découvre alors la double vie de Marcus : sept ans de perversions et d'infidélité avec sa meilleure amie. Entre un faux mari au cœur sincère et un vrai mari à l'âme factice, commence un jeu dangereux d'échange conjugal.

video:video.video:title: Never Meeting You After the Rain
video:video.video:description: After 7 years of hard work, the scumbag divorced her just to register Bai Yueguang's child? This time, she turned away in despair, and was later embraced by her childhood sweetheart and married in a wedding dress. The scumbag begged her to come back with red eyes, but she only said coldly, I don't love you anymore.

video:video.video:title: Meant to Be Yours
video:video.video:description: Samara Knight has been with Michael King for a whole eight years, only to find out that she is a mere substitute for someone else.

video:video.video:title: A Vow Of Joy And Sorrow [English]
video:video.video:description: Roger Nandlall, an abstinent CEO, cannot survive New Year's Eve because of his Yang body. However, he unexpectedly discovered that Brenda Cameron, a poor college student, was the only person in the world who can cure his Yin body. To survive, Roger married Brenda domineeringly. After learning that Brenda's life would be in danger after curing him, Roger, who slowly fell in love with Brenda, was faced with a painful choice between life and death...

video:video.video:title: Against the Tide: A Youth Rewritten
video:video.video:description: Given a second chance at life, she was determined to rewrite her fate. First, she took her sisters and completely shook off their past identities as delinquents, resolutely breaking up with her incompatible boyfriend to start a brand-new life. By a stroke of luck, she saved someones life, and this person later took the initiative to offer tutoring to them, bringing a turning point to their academic pursuits.

video:video.video:title: Miraculous Doctor Sis' Revenge
video:video.video:description: Miraculous Doctor Sis' Revenge

video:video.video:title: Supreme Martial Emperor
video:video.video:description: Only by cultivating with the opposite sex can one's skills improve by leaps and bounds. The young man's kindness helped him become a martial arts supreme and meet true love.

video:video.video:title: [ENG DUB] The Celestial Sovereign's Silent Vengeance
video:video.video:description: Cayden Freeman, the Celestial Sovereign of Azra, married Juliette Frost while concealing his identity and secretly supported the Frost family for three years. After intervening to save Alessia Walsh, the second daughter of the Walsh family, from trouble, he earned the enmity of Odin Wells, the Wells heir, and was simultaneously thrown out by Juliette. At an investment banquet, when Cayden faced false accusations and public anger, Alessia appeared and skillfully diffused the situation, marking the beginning of their relationship.

video:video.video:title: Chasing the Guilty Wife: The Indifferent CEO Knows
video:video.video:description: The maid Luo Wanwan turned around and became the wife of a wealthy family, but she was framed and killed by the male protagonist's biological eldest brother. She was tortured and escaped. Five years later, Luo Wanwan returned to China again to find out the truth of what happened back then. Her scumbag boyfriend also changed his feelings and finally led a happy life.

video:video.video:title: Destined To Be
video:video.video:description: When Adia Nordstrom steps into her sister's wedding shoes to save her family's honor, she finds herself tied to the elusive Stefan Vaughn, a man who exudes coldness and does not fail to show his disappointment at the union altogether. Their forced union, put together by a long-standing family pact, swoops Adia into a whirlwind of conflicting emotions as she struggles with her own shattered dreams and a husband who remains a mystery.

video:video.video:title: Chasing My Frozen Wife
video:video.video:description: On her mother’s funeral day, Amber discovered her husband’s betrayal. After seven years of pursuit and fifty proposals, their marriage crumbled under lies and neglect. On their anniversary, heartbroken, she chose to freeze herself —leaving behind only her husbands bitter regret and unbearable remorse.

video:video.video:title: Throne and Kin
video:video.video:description: The Sterling family, led by Edward Sterling, is exposed for their involvement in power struggles and a grain monopoly conspiracy. Thomas Sterling conspires with Lord Ashford in a rebellion, leading to a rift between mother and son. Margaret Benson unveils their crimes and aids the common people, earning the support of His Majesty the Emperor. Her Majesty the Empress Dowager willingly steps down in disgrace. Ultimately, the Sterling family collapses, Lord Ashford's coup fails, and Margaret chooses to leave the palace, embracing a simple life. His Majesty the Emperor restores peace by quelling the unrest and reassuring the people

video:video.video:title: The Wrong Twin Got Me Pregnant
video:video.video:description: After countless fertility treatments, Chanel is finally pregnant --- but the baby daddy is her husband's twin, not her husband. With a billion-dollar empire on the line, Chanel's husband and the family matriarch are willing to go to any length to claim the heir as his own child.

video:video.video:title: Drunken Sword: Conquer the Demon
video:video.video:description: Caleb Grant, Eva Croft, and allies seek revenge, uncovering a conspiracy involving the Surrey family and demon clans. They rescue Master Gale Croft, defend the Great Wall, and defeat the Surreys, with Eva ascending as the female emperor. Meanwhile, Drew Morris rejects an arranged marriage for Caleb, sparking new conflicts and adventures.

video:video.video:title: [Dubbed]Path Beyond Eternity
video:video.video:description: I love my school beauty wife very much, but I didn't expect that the male mistress would steal my wife! He even turned the tables and accused me of stealing her! Do you think you are rich? Do you want to see that I have a big boss grandfather? He has tens of billions of real estate! How dare you steal my wife!

video:video.video:title: The Wealthy Madame's Top Healer
video:video.video:description: The most beautiful girl in Lunan actually wants to marry Qin Feng! What magical ability does he have that not only wins the favor of the rich woman, but also makes the powerful bow down?

video:video.video:title: Lear, M.D., Lady of Hearts
video:video.video:description: She was killed by her stepmother while possessing a secret book, but she was reborn as an unpopular young lady in ancient times. As soon as she opened her eyes, she was forced to save a handsome boy. Fortunately, the handsome boy asked for a decree granting marriage, but who knew that he was actually Greedy for my body? !

video:video.video:title: The Ideal Match: Summer Love Melody
video:video.video:description: Sabrina Churchill has a one-night stand with Ernest Underwood. Six years later, her sister, Vanessa Churchill, impersonates her to secure a wealthy husband. Meanwhile, Sabrina becomes Ernest’s legal advisor, and their feelings for each other begin to blossom. Fearing the loss of her status, Vanessa repeatedly sabotages Sabrina, but each time, Ernest manages to resolve the conflicts. Ultimately, the truth comes to light, allowing Sabrina and her family to reunite as a happy trio.

video:video.video:title: True Love Waits
video:video.video:description: Anne mortgaged her house in order to give her son William a wedding, and because she couldn't pay off her debt in time, Anne's house was taken away. Anne went to find her son William, but her son's wife, Selene, drove her away. Anne saves girl Rebecca, Rebecca feels Anne's kindness, lets her and her father blind date, Anne and her father Leonardo Blind Date and success flash marriage. After her marriage, Leonardo stayed by Anne's side as she faced bullying from her son's family, relatives and ex-husband. then Leonardo is the boss of a top business empire! and Rebecca, is her long-lost biological daughter! After all this, Anne finally lived a happy life.

video:video.video:title: Boss, You've Got The Wrong Wife
video:video.video:description: Jennifer, an intern at the Wilson Group, had a drunken one-night stand with her boss, James. She also accidentally left her best friend Tina's resume in the hotel room. While James was looking for Jennifer, Tina cheated on him, moved into Wilson's house, and became his woman. Jennifer, who wanted to be a good intern but was unexpectedly promoted to secretary, stayed by James's side and carefully guarded the secret of the night. But James had developed a soft spot for Jennifer, and suspected she was the woman of the night.

video:video.video:title: Country Girl，CEO’s Wife.（Dubbed）
video:video.video:description: Olivia Charles is a young woman from the countryside who comes to the city to work. On her first night in the city, she is maliciously set up by her fellow villager Sabrina and, by accident, ends up having a one-night stand with a billionaire, Chandler Harrision. Because neither of them saw each other's face clearly, Sabrina pretended to be Chandler Harrision's girlfriend, hoping to marry into wealth. Olivia, relying on her own abilities, successfully lands a job as a housekeeper at the Chandler Harrision's hotel, and accidentally discover that the man she had a one-night stand with is her new boss. Olivia then finds out she is pregnant with his child, making matters more complicated.

video:video.video:title: Perfect Landing into your Arms
video:video.video:description: When single mom Diana starts working as an air traffic controller, she hears her ex-boyfriend Anthony’s voice over the radio. Since Diana broke up with him for the sake of his captain dreams, she’s grateful her sacrifice wasn’t in vain, and keeps hiding that he’s the father of her daughter. But she doesn’t know Anthony is actually the new billionaire CEO of their airline!

video:video.video:title: I'm pregnant, it's not yours
video:video.video:description: Husband prefers secretary, who looks like his white moonlight, over his wife Iris. Calmly, Iris asks for a divorce, revealing that the baby she's carrying isn't his. Five years later, she returns powerfully with her new flame, while Husband is left drowning in regret.

video:video.video:title: The Invincible Legend
video:video.video:description: As the heir to Nagar Palace, Tyler Ellis stays by Kaia Clarke’s side as an ordinary man to repay the favor of saving his life in the past. He helps and supports the Clarke family, but after Kaia rises to a higher status, she seeks to divorce him. Little does she know that the husband she despises wields influence over powerful figures.

video:video.video:title: MOVE ASIDE! IM THE EX BEYOND YOUR REACH!
video:video.video:description: Olivia and Derek die in a car crash on their way to divorce and are reborn as students. Seven years later, Olivia marries billionaire Asher, but a reunion with Derek and Jennifer leads to bullying and humiliation. Can Olivia fight back and take her revenge?

video:video.video:title: Daily Flirtations with a Rebellious Substitute Bride
video:video.video:description: He conspired to marry an ugly wife as a substitute. The ugly wife has no lower limit and keeps showing off! Unable to bear it anymore, he pushed his ugly wife into the corner and kissed her, "You have to pay a price for teasing." "Well, I'm just teasing..."

video:video.video:title: The Lust Game: Seduce Me If You Can
video:video.video:description: A virgin signs up for the ultimate seduction show—$5M on the line, no rules but lust. Stuck with her shameless ex, a dangerous lawyer, and a bad boy who knows exactly how to touch her, every task drags her deeper into temptation. To win, she must play with fire... even if it costs her innocence.

video:video.video:title: OMG! My Divorce Client Is My Billionaire Husband
video:video.video:description: Zoe and Alex met behind masks at a costume party and got married contractrally. Three years later, they cross paths again as strangers. Alex hires Zoe, now a lawyer, to end that marrige, without realizing he's fallen for the very wife he is trying to divorce.

video:video.video:title: [ENG DUB] Wed to the Unknown Heir
video:video.video:description: After her father had an affair and her mother passed away, Clara's stepmother moved in with her illegitimate son, throwing Clara into a world of trouble. The scheming stepmother wanted her own son to study abroad, so she pressured Clara to drop out of school and get married, using the dowry to fund her son's education. But Clara, determined not to give up on her dreams, took on all sorts of part-time jobs. One day, she saved an elderly lady, and through a twist of fate, ended up marrying the woman's grandson. Clara was ready to keep working hard to support herself, only to find out her new husband was actually a super-rich tycoon pretending to be a poor employee! Deciding to play along with his charade, a hilarious and absurd drama ensued!

video:video.video:title: Rebirth of the Billionaire Heiress: Return to the Mansion
video:video.video:description: After Zhixia was reborn, she became a billionaire and asked her ex-boyfriend to polish her shoes. She was severely humiliated. It was so enjoyable.

video:video.video:title: Rented a Billionaire Husband for Christmas
video:video.video:description: Seven years ago, they shared one night. Now they’re fake-married—with a child he doesn’t know is his.

video:video.video:title: The Gambling God Vanished Until the Final Hand
video:video.video:description: With his parents butchered by a gambling syndicate, Peter Gumbel trains under the Gambling God and returns as an unassuming casino waiter. As he defeats one gambling master after another, he protects his loved one's casino, uncovers the truth behind his family's tragedy, and wagers everything for the ultimate revenge.

video:video.video:title: Her Counterattack with Sixduplets After Divorced
video:video.video:description: The play tells the story of a divorced woman who, after encountering a marital crisis, relied on her wisdom and courage to lead her six children out of trouble, and eventually became a global figure.

video:video.video:title: The Seductress
video:video.video:description: "-Don't call me 'uncle' anymore. - Then what should I call you? Mr. President?" What do your teasing, your tears, really mean? I don't want to play this game with you anymore, can we truly love each other?

video:video.video:title: Sold As The Alpha King’s Breeder
video:video.video:description: Rosalie thinks her father sold her to the ruthless future Alpha King Ethan as a maid, but she's actually there to be his breeder. Though she falls for him, she learns he plans to kill her after childbirth. Heartbroken, she escapes with Madalynn’s help, faking her death. Ethan realizes too late she's his mate and searches for her. Rosalie starts a new life, but Ethan finds her, saves her from danger, and slowly earns back her love.

video:video.video:title: The Ashes of His Name(DUBBED)
video:video.video:description: Eason Morris was once the pride of his family—until they adopted Colin Yeats, a master manipulator who turned everyone against him. Betrayed by his parents and fiancée, Eason was thrown into prison and left to suffer. After his release, a twist of fate led him to Master Quinn, a legendary artist who took him in as his final student. When Eason faked his death and vanished, those who betrayed him—his fiancée, parents, and sister—were left drowning in regret.

video:video.video:title: The Mafia Boss is Addicted to My Touch
video:video.video:description: Six years ago, blindfolded Haley was bedded by Mafia boss Lester. Now ruined by her cheating husband Bill, she signs a healing marriage contract with Lester. Finding out Lester's daughter is her lost newborn secretly sold by Bill, Haley starts a thrilling new life -- slapping down the toxic exes while falling deeply in love with Lester.

video:video.video:title: The Betrayed Guardian: The Empire Begs Him Back
video:video.video:description: For ten years, Arthur stood alone against the Abyss. But the new Empress Valeria fell for a pack of lies and branded him a fraud, leaving the entire Empire to despise him. And that’s when the Archfiends emerged from the Abyss.

video:video.video:title: From Small-Town Outcast to Blooming Rose
video:video.video:description: As a child loved by no one, Ava suffered unfathomable abuse from her father and grandmother. On the eve of being forced to marry a scoundrel, Ava managed to flee from home with her mother's help. Years later, Ava is now a powerful CEO and returns to rescue her mother, only to walk into her family's trap. But she's a victim no longer - this time, she's back to destroy them all and seize her long-awaited vengeance.

video:video.video:title: OMG My Husband Is a Callboy [English]
video:video.video:description: When cold-hearted mayoral candidate Megan Ford's perfect image crumbles on live TV, she makes a desperate deal with charming callboy Max Wood - fake fiancé for hire. One hundred thousand dollars to play the role of devoted husband and save her political career. What starts as a cynical contract becomes a media circus of press conferences, scandals, and a fake wedding orchestrated by her ruthless campaign manager. But between the cameras and chaos, something real begins to spark between the ice queen politician and the carefree escort. Now with her past lies exposed and election day approaching, Megan must choose: stick to her perfectly controlled image or risk everything for the one person who made her feel human again.

video:video.video:title: Spoiled By The Alpha King With Her Triplets
video:video.video:description: Six years ago, Sister Alicia broke her vows to save a dying werewolf, and was cast out of the Church for carrying his child. Now she slips into the Alpha Estate with her son, a wolf pup carrying royal blood, unaware that the ruthless Alpha King is the boy's father. For six years he has searched for the woman who saved him, while the aging Old Wolf King grows desperate for a pureblood heir. Neither knows she is right under their noses, raising the very heir they've been looking for.

video:video.video:title: Top Gear Guy Finds His Mrs. Right
video:video.video:description: New short drama 'Top Gear Guy Finds His Mrs. Right' coming soon, please look forward to it.

video:video.video:title: The Heiress' Return: Three Brothers at Her Beck and Call
video:video.video:description: Refusing to settle for mediocrity within her esteemed family, Mia Gale, daughter of the affluent Gale family, rejects the indulgent lifestyle offered by her three brothers. Instead, she opts to pursue her own path, determined to carve out success through hard work and dedication.

video:video.video:title: [ENG DUB] Fatal Allure: Spoiling My Wife
video:video.video:description: She is a world renowned designer born in a super-rich family with a prestigious background. In order to repay a life-saving favor, she got married with the vegetable patient and took care of him for many years! However, on the day her husband woke up, he kicked her out and married his dream girl! After the divorce, her true identity was revealed! She made the scum ex and the despicable mistress feel so ashamed. Her ex-husband regretted it so much, but unfortunately, it was too late. She was already dating a good-looking young man…

video:video.video:title: The Iceberg Daddy and the Three Treasures
video:video.video:description: It mainly tells that Song Churan is Zhou Yanhuan's wife, but her sister is jealous of her and designs to frame Song Churan, making Zhou Yanhuan hate her in every possible way. Song's father even lost cooperation with the Zhou family because of this matter, and everyone Not even believing her, poor Song Churan was imprisoned in the room.

video:video.video:title: Hot Gardener's Seduction
video:video.video:description: Carol, having endured years of neglect and humiliating rejections from her husband William, finds her spirit withered. Her life changes when the young gardener—Arthur—intrudes upon her solitude. His intense gaze and unabashed allure leave her emotionally torn.Just as she succumbs to Arthur's ardent pursuit, rediscovering a passion long absent, Carol makes a devastating discovery: Arthur was planted by William.

video:video.video:title: Queen of the Court
video:video.video:description: After abandoning her career as a tennis star, Lily Pearson dedicated her life to helping her boyfriend Adam's tennis career. But after helping him win his own Grand Slam...the fame changed Adam for the worse. Adam's not only involved with a younger tennis star Mia Sparks, but he wants Lily to coach her as well. Will Lily accept this betrayal and love a cheating man she no longer recognizes, or will she have the courage to leave, and salvage her potential from all those years ago?

video:video.video:title: Don't Watch Me Waste Away
video:video.video:description: Believing that Celeste had indirectly caused his sister Gloria’s tragic death in prison, Byron let love curdle into hatred. For five years, he tortured Celeste’s body and soul—until the day he learned she was dead. Only then did regret set in.

video:video.video:title: Married an Elven King by Mistake
video:video.video:description: New short drama 'Married an Elven King by Mistake' coming soon, please look forward to it.

video:video.video:title: Don's Back: No One Touches His Daughter
video:video.video:description: Eighteen years ago, Leonardo Gambino ruled New York's underworld. At eighteen, he took control. By thirty-three, he survived a brutal war that buried half his brothers. That night, he learned his wife was pregnant—and for the first time, he had something greater than power: a family.So he walked away. He divided his fortune, abandoned his legend, and vanished with his wife and closest friend. Under a new name, he opened a small bar in a quiet town and built an ordinary life.Eighteen years later, no one recognizes the former Godfather in the gentle bartender. To his seventeen-year-old daughter Sofia, he is just Dad—a harmless man shielding her from his dark past.Then Sofia becomes the target of vicious bullies. Threatened and terrified, she lies to protect the father she believes is only a bartender. She has no idea what he used to be. Until Leonardo sees what they have done to her.Black cars arrive in the rain. Armed men emerge from shadows. Old soldiers bow before their Godfather. Luca stands at his side. And in the darkness, Dominic Gallo—believed dead—still lives.The Colombos think they have inherited his city. They are wrong. When the Gambino crest appears, Jack's arrogance crumbles. When hundreds answer one call, Jacob—once Leonardo's driver—realizes the truth: Leonardo did not disappear because he lost. He chose family over power. Now someone has hurt his daughter.Sofia watches in disbelief as her gentle father transforms. The bartender is gone. In his place stands the man who once made New York kneel—the Godfather whose name still commands fear and loyalty.Old enemies gather. Former allies return. The Colombos come for blood. Leonardo must decide how far he will go to protect the family he sacrificed everything to build. They have no idea they are touching the daughter of the Godfather.And when the man who made a city bow finally stops hiding—who will be left standing when his old name is spoken again?

video:video.video:title: Seeds of Hope: The Girl of Wonder
video:video.video:description: Abigail Carter awakens in the body of a six-year-old girl named Abby during a time of famine. Abandoned in the remote mountains under the cover of night and left to die, her fate seems sealed—until Sam Hutton, the poorest yet kindest man in the village, discovers and saves her. From that moment on, fortune begins to favor him: his harvests flourish, and he finally wins the heart of the woman he’s always loved.

video:video.video:title: Love Me Before the Clock Runs Out
video:video.video:description: On their seventh wedding anniversary, Josh Freeman receives a message from Spencer Harris—a photo of Yelena Scott in bed with him. Devastated, Josh decides to divorce her. However, their son, Chance, pleads for her to have three more chances. Josh grants them, but when Yelena wastes them all, he takes Chance and walks away for good. Only after losing Josh does Yelena realize she truly loves him—but by then, it's too late to undo her betrayal.

video:video.video:title: Boundless Romance: Allure Behind the Masks
video:video.video:description: Everyone thinks Sophie Lewis is nothing more than an ordinary and extremely unattractive person. Little do others know that behind her unassuming facade, she not only wields the power of a mysterious CEO but also conceals a rare beauty. Eventually, she marries a man thought to be physically challenged, only to discover later that he is, in fact, a wealthy and able-bodied billionaire.

video:video.video:title: Fading Facades: Love Beyond the Deal (DUBBED)
video:video.video:description: Qiana Cooper, born into a prestigious family, hides her identity to break free from her father's excessive indulgence. She travels to Green Land intending to marry John Collins, aspiring to lead an independent life. However, John becomes enamored with Cindy Smith, who portrays herself as an aristocrat. To ascend the social hierarchy, John divorces Qiana. Fueled by anger, Qiana enters into a marriage contract with Jack James, who happens to be in need of a partner.

video:video.video:title: My Heartless Wife
video:video.video:description: The two ends of this necklace connect us closely, let me stand beside you, whether you love it or hate it, let's taste it together.

video:video.video:title: (Doublage)LA VIERGE DESTINÉE DU ROI ALPHA
video:video.video:description: En 2135, le Roi Alpha Andrew est mourant : seul mordre la glande de la dernière Oméga de sang pur, Lynn, peut le guérir — mais cela lui coûtera la vie. Elle est sa perdition et son salut, mais Andrew jure de l'aimer et de la protéger, contre le destin.

video:video.video:title: Quand la Neige du Cœur Fond Enfin ( Doublé )
video:video.video:description: Un mariage de sept ans semblable à une neige implacable étouffant son cœur, Olivia Lambert a tout encaissé pour l'amour, mais n'a récolté que les tracasseries de sa belle-mère et l'indifférence de son mari. La vérité dévoilée, elle divorce avec détermination. Amir Lefèvre s'accable de remords, mais ne peut que la voir s'éloigner vers une renaissance dans ce printemps tardif. La neige s'évapore, l'amour s'évanouit en cendres...

video:video.video:title: O Quarterback Perdido Retorna
video:video.video:description: Quando Asher Bradshaw, filho do lendário quarterback do Hall da Fama da NFL, Trent Bradshaw, e da ex-rainha de beleza Krista, desaparece num incêndio devastador, Donny Lewis, um fã psicopata, vê a chance perfeita de trocar Asher pelo seu próprio filho, Wyatt. Doze anos depois, os dois garotos se enfrentam num treino de futebol americano, onde Asher supera Wyatt. Os Bradshaw, sem saberem que aquele garoto é o filho perdido deles, atacam-no sem limites. Eles o submetem a torturas físicas e psicológicas, incentivadas pelo filho adotivo, até que descobrem a verdade chocante – Asher sempre foi o filho que eles procuravam. Agora, os Bradshaws vão fazer de tudo para implorar por perdão, enquanto Wyatt e Donny planejam a sua vingança.

video:video.video:title: Love Under Contract
video:video.video:description: Jennifer Sullivan, a lawyer, becomes a spy for Isaac Marks in order to save her sister. In the midst of love, hate and conspiracy, she gradually uncovers the truth of the arson case, and when the murderer is finally caught and Isaac reforms, Jennifer decides to let go of her past and make a fresh start with Isaac.

video:video.video:title: Condemn Me, My President
video:video.video:description: Sold to the mob by her own boyfriend, Isabella flees straight into the arms of Will Clifton — President of the United States, and the last man she should want. He hides her in his world: quiet debts paid, a White House badge, stolen nights. But loving him this close to power draws enemies fast — an ex, a jealous fiancée, a country watching. The closer she tries to run, the harder he pulls her back.

video:video.video:title: Guardian to Groom
video:video.video:description: Secretly in love with her guardian and Alpha King, Calvin, Nora confesses on her 22st birthday, only to be cold-heartedly rejected. Heartbroken, she joins a lethal mission and takes a fatal hit. Facing her near-death, Calvin finally breaks his restraint—disowning her as guardian to claim her as his soulmate.

video:video.video:title: Her Favorite Dessert is Her Chef
video:video.video:description: After an award winning chef Valerie loses her partner and girlfriend to each other, they kick her out of her own restaurant leaving her with nothing. But her luck changes when she has a one nightstand with a gorgeous CEO named Isabella who turns out to be her cheating ex-businesses partner’s stepmother.

video:video.video:title: A Heart Only for You
video:video.video:description: Desperate to stay with the penniless Gemma Holt, wealthy heir Jerry Cobb cuts ties with his family, who disapprove of their marriage. But when she fails to secure the money for his heart transplant, Gemma lies—claiming she's just a gold-digger—to make him leave her. Years later, Jerry still resents her, unaware they share a child... and that Gemma's time is running out.

video:video.video:title: Sleeping Beside Danger
video:video.video:description: On Jane Shaw's birthday, she barely survives a car accident. But the moment she wakes up, she witnesses a horrifying scene as her husband, Sean Cole, and their maid, Tina Holt, are plotting her death. In an instant, every dream and hope she once had for a happy life in a loving home shatters. The man she loves most has become her greatest enemy, and Jane finds herself trapped like a pawn on a chessboard, waiting to be sacrificed.

video:video.video:title: My Heart Has Always Known
video:video.video:description: To save her mom from an abusive relationship with her father, Nina Judd agrees to take the place of her sister, who has vanished, in a marriage alliance with the heir of the powerful Zanes, Sean. Despite supposedly marrying into a life of luxury, she realizes her new husband is a workaholic who has little interest in her. Little does she know, her caring nature melts Sean's cold heart, and what appeared to be a marriage of benefit turns out to be the true love.

video:video.video:title: She Returns Crowned in Flames
video:video.video:description: On the day Lilibeth Rothwell awakens as the Duchess of Haldrake, she demands a divorce from her unfaithful husband and begins transforming into a woman far beyond his reach. Just as she starts to reclaim her life, he and Sharon Morris stir up even more trouble. But when Lilibeth crosses paths with Salazar Yowell, she discovers not just freedom—but true love.

video:video.video:title: What Broke Wasn't Just the Vow
video:video.video:description: Alicia Blair spends years trying to be the perfect wife to Jasper Kane—only to discover their "perfect" marriage is nothing but a lie. Just as she gathers the strength to leave and files for divorce, Jasper realizes too late that he's truly fallen for her.

video:video.video:title: Defying Doom: The Clash of Fate
video:video.video:description: In exchange for his divine powers as the Mystic Lord, Jason Long is destined for a short life. To change his fate, he embarks on a quest for the legendary Volatile. As events unfold, he becomes the live-in “unwanted” boyfriend of Rina Shaw, the heir to the prestigious Shaw family. Determined to protect her from his vengeful ex-girlfriend and a mysterious masked figure, Jason faces a series of challenges.

video:video.video:title: Ignition: Return of the Drift King
video:video.video:description: Former racing legend Chase Walker has lived under the radar as a humble mechanic in countryside for five years. However, the Raptor Riders shows up, challenging the locals to a high-stakes race. With the town’s future at stake, Chase must decide: stay hidden or dust off his skills for one last ride. Can the washed-up champion outdrive his past—and save their home?

video:video.video:title: A Love Rekindled
video:video.video:description: After falling victim to a scheme orchestrated by her half-sister, Ava Bale, who did not share the same mother, Eve Bale found herself in an unintentional encounter with Ken Stark, resulting in her pregnancy with twins. Upon hearing the news, Ava took one of Eve’s sons, Dean Stark, and replaced Eve as Ken’s fiancée. With no other options, Eve went abroad and raised her other son on her own.Five years later, she returns to expose Ava's scheming plans.

video:video.video:title: Revenge Marriage Sweet Love
video:video.video:description: Cate's sister Rebecca had not only stolen her boyfriend Ethan, but had also stripped her of her inheritance. Fueled by desire for revenge, a drunken Cate impulsively decided to seduce Ethan's handsome uncle, Shaun, who later was ignited by Cate and fell madly in love despite his cold demeanor. However, when they both realized Shaun was mistaken as Ethan's uncle, Shaun realized that she initially approached him only for revenge against Ethan, putting their love to the test.

video:video.video:title: Leashed to My Demanding Boss 24/7
video:video.video:description: Beth’s world shatters when her boyfriend proposes to her sister on her birthday. Heartbroken, she drunkenly marries a stranger in Vegas, then flees the next morning with no memory of him. Back home, she starts a new job as the assistant to the charismatic billionaire Logan Bennette—only to discover he’s the man she married. And to top it all off, she’s pregnant.

video:video.video:title: The Billionaire Married a Homeless Girl
video:video.video:description: After a one-night-stand, Adele Moore becomes pregnant. She wants to keep the child, but her father kicks her out of the house. With nowhere else to go, Adele becomes homeless. She tries her best to raise her son despite her challenging circumstances. One day, Adele's son, Brad Moore, runs into billionaire Heston Deleon. By chance, Heston discovers that Brad is his son. He tries to track down Brad, but loses their trail. Through a series of misunderstandings, Adele and Heston become entangled again!

video:video.video:title: Wham, Bam, Love Struck Here
video:video.video:description: Dressed in plain attire, Joel Price is about to visit his grandmother when he is hit by a car driven by Melody Carson near a guard post. Melody thinks she ran over a security guard and is dismissive of him, but the kind-hearted Mary Carson brings him to the hospital. When Mary visits her mom, Joel's mom takes a liking to her and wants to make Mary her granddaughter-in-law. However, Mary refuses.

video:video.video:title: The Presidents Guileful Girl
video:video.video:description: She pretended to be foolish and came close to him to investigate the truth, but her heart was drawn to him at one point as well. But when the truth was revealed, the two lovers became at a loss as to what to do.

video:video.video:title: My Parents, The Undercover Billionaires (DUBBED)
video:video.video:description: The wealthiest couple in the world, Dylan Earl and Helen Gray, finally reunite with their long-lost son, Ryan Earl. To test his character, they choose to disguise themselves as humble laborers when meeting him. To their surprise, Ryan not only accepts their background but also introduces his girlfriend, Alicia Finn, to them. However, the Finn family looks down upon Dylan and Helen, prompting Ryan to call off the engagement to protect his parents.

video:video.video:title: Second Chance With Mafia Lover
video:video.video:description: Nadia discovers she's pregnant with Renzo's child, but his mafia father forces her to break up with him to save his life. Years later, they reunite under hostile circumstances, with Renzo now engaged to another woman. As secrets unravel—including their daughter's leukemia and Diana's schemes—Renzo learns the truth. After rescuing Nadia and their child from Diana, they reconcile and vow to stay together as a family.

video:video.video:title: His Son, Her Crown（Dubbed）
video:video.video:description: To escape her mother's forced marriage scheme, Ji Tiantian leaves home after an unexpected pregnancy with Jiang Mubai. Five years later, Jiang discovers their child and pursues her. Jealous rival Yu Zhiyin sabotages Tiantian repeatedly. In a crisis, Jiang saves Tiantian and their son — just as she uncovers she is the true heiress of the Yu family, switched at birth by her "mother".

video:video.video:title: Le Héros Qui Marche Parmi Nous ( Doublé )
video:video.video:description: Florian Bellamy, le Maître Divin de Magnalia, vit simplement comme balayeur après sa retraite. Chassé de chez lui par sa belle-famille, il sauve une jeune femme qui lui présente sa mère, une femme d'affaires influente. Intriguée, celle-ci le teste en demandant à son amie de le séduire. Contre toute attente, Florian appelle la police, dénonçant la tentatrice comme une femme de petite vertu.

video:video.video:title: [Doublé] Substitut accidentel pour Alpha
video:video.video:description: Ella a une peur bleue des loups-garous, et maintenant elle est enceinte de l'un d'entre eux. Forcée de contracter un mariage avec l'Alpha milliardaire Dominic Moon, elle doit cacher son identité pour survivre.

video:video.video:title: (Doublage) ÉVASION PAR LE BASSIN
video:video.video:description: (Doublage) ÉVASION PAR LE BASSIN

video:video.video:title: Happily Ever After: Spoiled by My Billionaire Husband
video:video.video:description: Abby Yates is devastated when she discovers her sister and fiancé's affair. Driven by impulse, she hastily marries Levi Lawson, a billionaire she barely knows, and their lives plunge into a whirlwind of dramatic twists and turns. With newfound determination, Abby fights back against those who have taken advantage of her, reclaiming what rightfully belongs to her. Levi stands by her side, offering unwavering support as she faces bullying and oppression from her own family.

video:video.video:title: Surrender is Your Only Escape
video:video.video:description: Five years ago, Coraline Judd crossed Jason Lawson's forbidden line—drugging him and vanishing after a night of forbidden passion. Now, even while hiding her true identity, she can't escape his grasp when they cross paths again—for the trap was set the moment their eyes first met.

video:video.video:title: Mr. Fu's Lost Rose
video:video.video:description: A tug of war between extremes, a journey from marriage to love, and a mutual teasing game—ultimately, who emerges as the victor?

video:video.video:title: True Love Behind Thick Fogs
video:video.video:description: Jian Lanyin helped her best friend Jiang Lili to cover the night shift and rescued Qin Xiaohan, who was out of control due to internal force backlash. Unexpectedly, his best friend twisted the truth and replaced him. She thought it would be over, but Jian Lanyin accidentally saved Qin Xiaohans sister and Qin Xiaohan started to fight again. together. With the witty assistance of her younger sister, they worked together to expose Jiang Lilis plot to pass the fake as real. Jian Lanyins biological brother Shen Su directly exposed Jiang Lilis conspiracy at the recognition site and brought her to justice. The two finally got together happily.

video:video.video:title: Everything's on My Side: Daddy, I'm Coming
video:video.video:description: During a conflict with the Quinn fake heiress, young Ellie Quinn gets hurt while protecting her ill mother, unexpectedly awakening her ability to hear the voices of everything in the world. As impostors take their places in the reunion with her wealthy father, Ellie speaks to the world—animals, vases, and even desks—guiding her mother toward their true home.

video:video.video:title: How I Made the Alpha Mine
video:video.video:description: Luca Conri is the wolf-less runt of the Nightreign Pack, whose bark is bigger than his bite. Tormented by his own Pack and hunted by rivals, Luca is reluctantly put under the protection of his dominant Alpha -- and older brother's best friend -- Dalton Grey. However, everything changes when the two become fated mates, a bond that violates the natural order of the Pack. As enemies close in and traditions try to tear them apart, Luca and Dalton must decide if they want to give into their lustful temptations in a forbidden romance that threatens their own lives.

video:video.video:title: King of Underworld
video:video.video:description: Wayne, secretly the invincible Hades, cures his wife Wendy's paralysis. But when elites demand she marry the ruthless Zane heir for profit, Wayne must unleash his true power. Surrounded by deadly conspiracies and a fake Hades, can the true King protect his love before rival families destroy everything?

video:video.video:title: The Beast on Her Leash
video:video.video:description: To find evidence of Vincent's crimes—the murderer of her parents—Eliza accepts an invitation from Vincent's father to become the president of Evertech AI. Unexpectedly, the father imposes an additional condition: she must educate his youngest son, Ryder, who is as ferocious as a wild beast, into a civilized man. After agreeing, Eliza finds Ryder an extremely difficult man to handle, and the two often clash with intense tension.

video:video.video:title: Sorry, Your Uncle's Hotter
video:video.video:description: Jodie Walsh finds herself transmigrated into a romance novel as the ex-wife who got screwed over. The original character spent five years in an arranged marriage with a CEO tyrant, giving him everything—money, property, her whole heart—only to end up with her family destroyed and herself behind bars. And it gets worse. Her parents, best friend, childhood friends, and basically everyone connected to her was just cannon fodder in the story. Well, time for Jodie to roll up her sleeves and rewrite this mess. Mr. Hotshot CEO? She's going to see how mighty he is after bankruptcy. The pure, innocent female lead? Honey, let's add some darkness to that light. Her parents jumping to their deaths? Not in her version. They'll be doing the disco on her ex-mother-in-law's grave instead. Her bestie killed by her abusive husband? Hmm... such a "wonderful" husband. Let's save him for the female lead's bestie. Her broke aristocratic childhood friends? Here, one business opportunity each, and boom, instant CEOs, easy peasy. And the supposed villain? With that face and those abs? No one's going to object to him being the male protagonist. What's that? You're asking what makes her so badass? Jodie beckons to the mafia boss. "Babe, you tell them." "Simple." Mafia boss grins. "She's the boss lady."

video:video.video:title: Revenge Served Cold: A Life Reclaimed (DUBBED)
video:video.video:description: Deeply in love with Jane York, the daughter of his driver, Zayn Smith gave her everything—his time, wealth, and heart. In return, he fell victim to a cruel scheme, ultimately losing his life at her hands. Now reborn back to his college days, Zayn is determined to reclaim everything he lost. This time, he sees Jane for who she truly is: a regular girl pretending to be the daughter of a wealthy family.

video:video.video:title: Heart's Vengeance: The Sheng Affair
video:video.video:description: Falling in love with Sheng Jingyuan, Ning Qianqian was forced to have a miscarriage, and her family was ruined. She burned herself in flames, faked her death and returned, vowing to take revenge.

video:video.video:title: Une Nuit Passionnée Avec Le PDG
video:video.video:description: Après une nuit avec Sébastien Yvard, Cynthia Yvon est remplacée par sa sœur Quitterie. Six ans plus tard, Cynthia devient juriste pour Sébastien, et leurs sentiments grandissent. Malgré les manigances de Quitterie, la vérité éclate, et la famille se réunit enfin.

video:video.video:title: The CEO's Surprise Daughter (DUBBED)
video:video.video:description: When Alvin Linton, CEO of Linton Corp, is severely injured, Hayley Linton saves him by donating blood. Grateful, Alvin offers to repay her—only for Hayley to call him her father in public. This sparks a journey to rescue her mother, Nina Sawyer, from an asylum. Though Alvin succeeds, Nina breaks down upon learning his true identity, accusing him of wasting eight years of their lives. Determined to make amends, Alvin helps Nina reclaim her family legacy from Alex Sawyer.

video:video.video:title: Lost Heiress: A Whirlwind Romance with Him
video:video.video:description: When the billionaire Webster, wounded and desperate, takes refuge in a hotel, one passionate night he spent with the enigmatic Dalle forges a bond that neither time nor turmoil can break. But their brief encounter becomes a storm of betrayal and greed, as Dalle’s life is torn apart by those who seek to control her fate. Just as all hope fades, a missing ring resurfaces, pulling Webster back into her world.

video:video.video:title: I Accidentally Claimed Four Royals With A Kiss
video:video.video:description: Modern girl Sylvia is transported to a magical world as a powerless nobody. Desperate, she binds a "Love Contract System"—only by kissing powerful mages can she survive and share their power. She kisses icy genius Adrian, awakens immense magic, then bonds with elves, dragons, and shadow lords. But the contract hides a secret that could unleash an ancient evil. With dark forces closing in, can Sylvia balance the backlash and her true heart?

video:video.video:title: Tuned to Your Heart
video:video.video:description: At five years old, Luna York and William Grant are orphaned and eventually lose contact with each other. Years later, Luna mistakes Wilson Lowe for William and sacrifices her future for him at eighteen—only to face humiliation and mistreatment. Framed for plagiarism, she is rescued by the real William, who recognizes her but hesitates to reunite—until the truth finally comes to light.

video:video.video:title: A Dance Between Chains and Freedom
video:video.video:description: In her past life, Sarah Garner was sent as a hostage and tortured to death. Reborn outside King Cyrus' camp, she chooses a new path—captivating Cyrus with her dance instead of becoming a miserable prostitute. Though kept under threat, Sarah pretends to obey while secretly plotting revenge. She manipulates the man who once abused her and spreads rumors about Cyrus, all while staying close enough to slowly win his heart.

video:video.video:title: Plan B Bride: She Who Turned the Tables
video:video.video:description: Madge Pearce, a transmigrated daughter, marries into the infamous Marquis Manor in place of her reborn sister. By the time her long-missing husband—rumored to be a womanizer—returns years later, she has already built a fortune of her own. Yet the moment they meet, something about him feels strangely different.

video:video.video:title: Out of the Abyss: Ready to Strike
video:video.video:description: Falling into her stepsister Kathy Ford’s trap, Cindy Ford is severely injured and loses the Mystery Box that her biological mother left for her on the night before marrying Miguel Wood. Fortunately, she is saved by the Divine Healer, Ken Shaw. She returns after three years with the medical techniques she learned from Ken and the vast wealth of the Astral Alliance to ruin Kathy and Miguel’s wedding.

video:video.video:title: Not Your Second Choice
video:video.video:description: Growing up in a biased family, Aurora Smith suffers torment from a young age, and Lucas Shaw is the only light in her youth.
