Even as an adult, she still lives in the shadows of her family's mistreatment and is forced to marry a stranger for three million dollars by her parents and younger brother. Little does she know, a great turning point in fate awaits.

video:video.video:title: The Naive King and the Beauty Reversed
video:video.video:description: Travel through time and become the stupid king and the ugly concubine. The short dramas are constantly exciting and the capacity is locked!

video:video.video:title: Ascend: The Funeral Start
video:video.video:description: The man who was not wearing military uniform had just come back to visit his ancestor's grave. Unexpectedly, he took a shovel and was going to dig up his ancestral grave. Upon seeing this, the man hurriedly yelled at them to stop, but the arrogant and domineering rich second generation did not care at all. He took it seriously, picked up a shovel and was about to blow the man's head off. Unexpectedly, he was blown away dozens of meters by the man's peerless martial arts. It turned out that the man's identity was not simple. He was the head of the Tang family with all the power in the world. Back then, Tang In order to promote his sect, Lao Ye passed on his lifelong skills to men. However, the arrogant and domineering rich second generation was immediately unconvinced, so he led his men to dig the grave. Unexpectedly, these men were no match for the young man... ..

video:video.video:title: Huo's Exclusive Love
video:video.video:description: The eldest daughter of the Shen family, Shen Yunxi,'s mother died young and her father's lover came to power. In order to get back the Shen Group founded by her mother, Shen Yunxi had no choice but to marry Huo Jingchen, the eldest son of the richest man, Huo Huo, for her step-sister Shen Qingqing. Huo Jingchen was hunted down and turned into a fool a year ago. Shen Yunxi thought that life would be more miserable, but she didn't expect that her fool husband was very caring. While getting along with Huo Jingchen, Shen Yunxi fell in love with Huo Jingchen. In fact, Huo Jingchen was not a fool. He just wanted to pretend to be stupid to lure out the real murderer who was chasing him a year ago. His attitude towards Shen Yunxi also changed from testing her in every possible way at the beginning to gradually falling in love with her, and Shen Yunxi also got help from Huo Jingchen. Returning to the Shen Group, the two worked together to find the murderer of Huo Jingchen and bring him to justice.

video:video.video:title: Remorseful Tears: Her Regret After Divorce
video:video.video:description: After breaking off the engagement, the cold-hearted goddess of war regretted it. She looked down on him in the past, but now he is beyond her reach.

video:video.video:title: Love When It's Deep to the Bone
video:video.video:description: Xia Zeyuan always believed that Lu Youran caused his sister to die. He chose to torture her, take revenge on her, and not listen to her explanation. He hates her and loves her at the same time. Can the misunderstanding between the two be resolved one day?

video:video.video:title: A Heart Set Free
video:video.video:description: On the day Cora Irwin is set to marry Gavin Royce, her heart shatters when Gavin chooses Leila Black over her. Devastated, Cora ends their relationship and severs all ties with him. By the time Gavin realizes his mistake and regrets his decision, it is already too late.

video:video.video:title: Reborn, Reviled, and Ridiculously Loved
video:video.video:description: Betrayed, business legend Jane Spencer wakes up as Mira Quill, a rural woman who married the Hewitts' disabled heir in place of her stepsister. Scorned by those around her, she rises in high society and the business world, ultimately bringing down the abusive Quill family and the unfaithful scumbag who framed her.

video:video.video:title: Whirlpool
video:video.video:description: The eldest daughter of the Cang family, Can Ling, was betrayed by her fiancé Qian Chen and her stepsister Cang Qing. By chance, she got married to Mou Yu, the president of the Mou Group. With the help of Mou Yu, Can Ling fought back against those who had hurt her. What's more, He shined brightly in his career, lived out his self-worth, and finally succeeded in gaining happiness with Mou Yu

video:video.video:title: Underestimated, Unmatched, Unstoppable
video:video.video:description: After transmigrating into the body of a despised man in Wallera, Elias Whitmore devotes himself to genuinely caring for the people and rewriting the dark reputation that haunts him. Enduring public humiliation and facing deadly crises, he perseveres, navigating the intricate dynamics with both the duke's daughter and the princess. Rising above his past, Elias transforms into a radiant and inspiring figure, leaving a legacy no one could have imagined.

video:video.video:title: [Dubbed] I Saved You, You Forgot Me
video:video.video:description: Iris Ross, the woman who saved Adam Ford, is caught in a web of betrayal and truth, torn between him and Luke Stark, a figure from her past. As revenge unfolds, Adam begins to regret his past actions when he learns the truth. Now, Iris must decide: seek revenge or trust her own strength to finally break free from the forces that bind her.

video:video.video:title: The Wife's Counterattack [English]
video:video.video:description: Ouyang Mu married Liang Muqing only for Mu Qing's family property, but behind his back, he had already been involved with Mu Qing's best friend Li Feier, and Mu Qing already knew all this

video:video.video:title: The Childhood Friend I Couldn't Resist
video:video.video:description: Ethan, the richest man in the Capital, met the spirited young Sia while recovering from a serious childhood illness. Her encouragement helped him survive, but she disappeared before their promised reunion. Eighteen years later, they meet again. Afraid of losing her, Ethan rushes into marriage, only to discover that Sia has been part of the plan all along. From the very start, their love has been a two-way chase, culminating in a long-awaited, perfect ending.

video:video.video:title: In the Palm of His Hand
video:video.video:description: College senior Shelby Yates accidentally saves the life of billionaire ex-mafia CEO Matteo Franconi. He immediately falls in love with her and pressures her to marry him. Is he as dangerous and cruel as he seems?

video:video.video:title: My CEO Son Kicks The Adopted Traitor
video:video.video:description: Joyce Shaw has been secretly drugged for years by her adopted son Felix and his wife, set to be a “heart donor” for his mother-in-law. On the eve of surgery, she uncovers the deadly plot and flees. Billionaire Jason Shaw recognizes her birthmark and confirms she’s his lost mother. But can he save her before it’s too late...?

video:video.video:title: The Wife Who Burned
video:video.video:description: Betrayed and framed, Katniss Frost returns under a new identity with her son. With vengeance in her heart and a mission to save her critically ill daughter, she decides to confront her ex-husband, Garrick Unwin. But this time, he's the one who's going to burn.

video:video.video:title: Back to Win It All
video:video.video:description: Betrayed by Elise Rowan, Nathan Chandler dies saving his daughter, Lila. Back in the '90s with a second shot, he cuts ties with Elise, builds his fortune, and heads for Southmere. But the past isn't done with him—and this time, he's ready!

video:video.video:title: Princess in Disguise: The Healer Who Saved a Dynasty
video:video.video:description: The seventh princess, Ariana Zeller, grows up among commoners while the emperor and her three brothers search for her. Saved by the former sect leader of the Sacred Healers, she rises to become the sect’s new leader. However, she hides her identity and repays a favor by marrying the top scholar—who secretly plots against her. Meanwhile, the princes arrive to reunite with their long-lost sister.
